name: pico-sdk
readme_excerpt: Raspberry Pi Pico SDK The Raspberry Pi Pico SDK (henceforth the SDK) provides the headers, libraries and build system necessary to write programs for the RP-series microcontroller-based devices such as the Raspberry Pi Pico or Raspberry Pi Pico 2 in C, C++ or assembly language. The SDK is designed to provide an API and programming environment that is familiar both to non-embedded C developers and embedded C developers alike.
